title: Hard engineering lifecycle harness (task state, VALID_RED replay, execution accounting, CI lifecycle gate)

spec.problem: Policy prose was not enforced: an agent could skip RED, claim VERIFIED with skipped/unexecuted tests, misclassify, weaken tests/baselines, or close work whose evidence did not match the merged code.

acceptance.text: Machine-readable policy (docs/engineering/engineering-policy.json) derives required gates from classification + changed paths; paths force classes

Task lifecycle CLI (pnpm quality) records START_HEAD, spec, classification and harness-produced evidence in tasks/<ID>.json; close refuses unless every derived gate has evidence bound to the final content fingerprint

VALID_RED is machine evidence: target executed and failed with declared expect text against base production code; skips, compile/import failures, infra signatures and passing tests are rejected; CI replays RED/GREEN/sensitivity
Suites record execution accounting (executed/passed/failed/skipped/unexpected skips); missing accounting, zero executed, unexpected skips or tool failure never count as PASS

CI lifecycle job rejects unowned changes, misclassification, stale evidence, unclosed tasks, forbidden test/CI weakening and unacknowledged high-risk changes; quality-system invariants (deploy SHA, no continue-on-error, DB-backed Go gate) are checked
BLOCKED requires the blocker protocol incl. known in-process alternatives; a BLOCKED gate yields PARTIAL, never VERIFIED
Claude Code PreToolUse hook denies production writes before SPECIFIED/CLASSIFIED/VALID_RED and evidence tampering; limits documented honestly
Adversarial self-test suite proves each bypass class is caught

red_exception.reason: The lifecycle harness is a new component: its tests import modules that do not exist at the base commit, so a RED would be a meaningless import failure. Sensitivity (mutation replay) + adversarial suite + independent review replace it.

targets.test: RED judgement > accepts only an executed failure containing the expected text

risk_acknowledgements.reason: False positive by design: the line is the detector's own regex for '|| true' in workflows, not a swallowed failure.
New dedicated config for the harness suite (allowOnly: false, passWithNoTests: false); run by verify-harness.sh in the CI lifecycle job.

Root config excludes scripts/quality/harness/** because those tests drive real git/go processes and run via verify-harness.sh (required-file list enforced); no existing test is removed from the root run.
